name: Gobbo
summary: Gobbo is an online multiplayer game that mixes horror, exploration, and the movement style from Gorilla Tag to make something that’s fast, fun, and easy to pick up. You don’t need to be super skilled to enjoy it, and you can go at your own pace whether that means running around with friends or taking your time exploring on your own.
